query: Consider FullStory's Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document specify whether the Receiving Party is required to destroy or return Confidential Information upon the termination of the Agreement?
gold: 7. All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement will be and will remain the property of the Discloser; all such information in tangible form will be returned to Discloser promptly upon written request or upon the termination or expiration of this Agreement, and will not thereafter be retained in any form by Recipient or its Affiliates or any of their employees.
rag_answer:
Yes. FullStory’s Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement specifies that, upon termination or expiration of the Agreement, the Receiving Party must return Confidential Information in tangible form to the Discloser promptly, and the information “will not thereafter be retained in any form” by the Recipient, its Affiliates, or their employees.

The Agreement does not expressly require the Receiving Party to “destroy” Confidential Information; it requires return of tangible materials and prohibits retention in any form.

judge.gold_summary: 协议第7条规定，保密信息仍归披露方所有；有形形式的保密信息应在书面请求或协议终止/到期时尽快返还披露方，且接收方及其关联方、员工不得再以任何形式保留。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出协议规定接收方在协议终止或到期时须尽快返还保密信息的有形形式，且不得再以任何形式保留；同时说明协议未明确要求“销毁”。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标关键要点：终止/到期时返还保密信息、不得保留；其补充说明未明确要求销毁也与金标不矛盾。
